correctness.rationale: From conditional depth martingale innovations ξ_j and their exact recurrence v_{j+1}=(1-p_j²)v_j+p_j(1-p_j), var(T_n)=sum_{j<=n}[1+(n-j)p_j]^2 v_j. Summation yields v_j~c j^(1-β)/(1-β), with sum_j p_j² v_j having exponent 1-3β. Riemann-beta integration for β<2/3 gives coeff 2c³/[(1-β)(2-3β)(3-3β)(4-3β)], critical harmonic sum gives 3c³ n²log n; for β>2/3 orthogonal martingale series converges a.s. and L², Kronecker controls centered remainder. The finite exact enumeration checker over sizes 3..7 validates recurrence for sample weights; independent recurrence numerics at n=20k for β=.6,2/3,.8 show expected scaling trend, not asymptotic proof. Nonzero ξ_3 variance implies σ²>0.
